title: WordPress metadata creates retain their live parent and safe native Undo
steps: Run the HTTP writer cases for WordPress metadata creates and Undo.
expect: Missing image and template metadata use existing or resolved new parent IDs.
Undo uses only the dedicated native receipt and verifies deletion.
Changed values, newer native receipts, missing receipts and uncertain outcomes preserve customer data.
A new parent stays published if dependent metadata Undo is held.
Lost responses and ACK recovery never resend a mutation.

tests: WordPress missing featured-image and page-template meta retain the existing parent post address
WordPress new-post meta uses the resolved live parent ID and does not create another post
WordPress new parent stays published when its metadata Undo is held: changed
